destinations.name: Kazakhstan
destinations.note: Central Asia's empty quarter — Charyn Canyon, steppe horizons, the Tian Shan foothills. Barely on anyone's circuit.

destinations.name: Finnish Lapland
destinations.note: Aurora season, reindeer country, silence you can actually hear. Go when the lakes are frozen solid.

destinations.name: The Dolomites, Italy
destinations.note: Via ferrata and rifugios above the treeline. Shoulder season, not the August crowds.

destinations.name: The American Wild
destinations.note: Still narrowing the region — the Tetons, the Pacific Northwest, Alaska's interior. One at a time, not a road-trip checklist.

destinations.name: Brazil
destinations.note: The Amazon basin over the beach towns — where the river is the road.

destinations.name: Peru
destinations.note: Machu Picchu is the excuse; the Andes and the trail in are the actual point.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.note: The outer atolls, not the resort strip off Malé. Empty sandbars over infinity pools.

destinations.name: Thailand
destinations.note: National parks over Bangkok and Phuket — Khao Sok, the quiet islands nobody's flying into yet.

destinations.name: Japan
destinations.note: The Japanese Alps and Hokkaido's wilder north — still deciding which. Tokyo and Kyoto aren't the trip.

destinations.name: Hawaii
destinations.note: Big Island lava fields and Waipiʻo Valley over the Waikiki strip. Active ground, not a resort loop.

destinations.name: Austria
destinations.note: Hohe Tauern and the Grossglockner road — a different range and pace from the Dolomites next door.

destinations.name: France
destinations.note: The French Alps and Corsica's GR20 over the Chamonix tour buses — Mont Blanc without the queue.

destinations.name: Iceland
destinations.note: The interior highlands over the Ring Road — Landmannalaugar, Vatnajökull's ice caves, geothermal steam with nobody around.

destinations.name: Patagonia
destinations.note: Torres del Paine and the ice fields — the trekking capital of the far south, still mostly empty once you're past the first ridge.

destinations.name: New Zealand
destinations.note: Fiordland over Queenstown — Milford Track terrain without the day-trip buses.

destinations.name: Georgia
destinations.note: Svaneti's stone towers under 5,000-meter peaks — Europe's wildest mountains, barely discovered yet.

destinations.name: Faroe Islands
destinations.note: Eighteen islands, no crowds, cliffs that drop straight into the North Atlantic. Weather does whatever it wants.

destinations.name: Bhutan
destinations.note: The only country that caps visitor numbers on purpose — Himalayan wilderness that stays wilderness.

destinations.name: Mongolia
destinations.note: The Gobi's Flaming Cliffs and endless steppe — more horses than roads, more silence than anything else.

destinations.name: Namibia
destinations.note: Sossusvlei's red dunes and Etosha's waterholes — some of the darkest night skies left on Earth.

milestones.note: Dossier opened. Twenty places on the atlas so far, all favoring wild terrain over crowded ones. The plan: build the online business first, then spend real, extended stretches out in the world, with a home base that stays just as real.
